summary: Retested caret-follow-scroll in TypeOverEngine on Ask AI Practice mode using the new getScrollParent + explicit delta-scroll implementation. Seeded an 1821-char water-cycle assistant message under demo user (Gemini rate-limited). Typed 1000 chars on desktop 1920x800 and 600 chars on mobile 390x844 via page.focus + page.keyboard.type. Character registration still works correctly (grey=0/200 in typed range). However the primary review-request expectation FAILS again on both viewports: the caret drifts BELOW the viewport bottom and never recovers. Additionally, a NEW critical regression appeared on desktop: a React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' runtime error overlay is thrown during practice typing (visible full-page overlay).

ui_bugs.component: TypeOverEngine caret follow-scroll (retest of iteration_12 fix)
ui_bugs.issue: The new getScrollParent + delta-scroll logic (lines 3-11 and 112-125 of TypeOverEngine.jsx) is NOT effective. Only ONE correction ever fires per session, then the caret keeps drifting down without further scroll adjustments. Desktop 1920x800: caret band goes 43.6% -> 61.6% (typed 50->250), single correction jumps back to 47.8% at 300 chars, then band walks up unimpeded: 52.3, 56.8, 61.3, 65.8, 70.3, 74.8, 79.3, 83.8, 88.3, 92.8, 97.3, 101.8, 106.3, 110.8% -- 3/20 samples off-screen (band>100%). Mobile 390x844 is worse: band walks 42.4 -> 55.2 -> 52.3 (one small correction) -> 65.1 -> 77.6 -> 86.5 -> 99.3 -> 112.1 -> 120.6 -> 133.4 -> 145.9 -> 154.7%. 5/12 samples off-screen. Post-typing inspection of the scroll parent on mobile shows: {tag:'DIV', class:'flex-1 overflow-y-auto ...', scrollTop:132, scrollHeight:3875, clientHeight:555, atMax:false}. So getScrollParent IS finding the correct scroller (the AskAI messages container) and it has ~3320px of headroom, but scrollTop stayed at 132 after 600 chars of typing -- meaning the `scroller.scrollTop += delta` assignments are either not executing on later keystrokes or are being reverted. Only the first correction stuck. Threshold logic looks right (`rel > viewH*0.7` should fire well before caret exits viewport), so the failure is that repeated deltas aren't being applied/preserved on the scroll parent.

ui_bugs.component: AskAI Practice mode - React runtime error
ui_bugs.issue: During desktop 1920x800 practice typing session, a React 'Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component repeatedly calls setState inside componentWillUpdate or componentDidUpdate.' error overlay was thrown (visible red full-page overlay). Stack points at dispatchSetState -> processDispatchQueue -> batchedUpdates. Most likely culprit is the caret useEffect (deps [input, chars]) doing setCaret + scroller.scrollTop mutation, combined with the AssistantMessage re-renders. This is a NEW regression not present in iteration_12.

action_items: Debug why `scroller.scrollTop += delta` at TypeOverEngine.jsx:122 only takes effect on the first correction. Suspicions: (a) delta is being computed against a stale rect after a first scroll while the effect is batched with setCaret re-render, (b) something (React StrictMode double-invocation? AskAI parent effect?) is resetting scrollTop. Try wrapping the scroll in a requestAnimationFrame after DOM commit, or use scroller.scrollTo({top: scroller.scrollTop + delta, behavior:'auto'}). Also consider running the scroll adjustment as a *layout* effect (useLayoutEffect) so the caret rect is fresh.

Fix the 'Maximum update depth exceeded' React error on desktop practice mode. Likely the caret useEffect triggers a setState (setCaret) that changes some parent state, which re-runs the effect. Guard setCaret against no-op writes (compare left/top/height before setState) and use useLayoutEffect so scroll mutations happen synchronously before paint.

Consider lowering the trigger threshold from 0.7 to 0.55-0.6 on mobile, since a single missed correction (as observed here) makes the caret drop 3-4 lines below viewport very quickly at leading-2 large font.
critical_code_review_comments: TypeOverEngine.jsx:96-126 -- The caret effect mixes state updates (setCaret) with DOM side effects (scroller.scrollTop, window.scrollBy). Recommend useLayoutEffect + memoized/idempotent setCaret so React doesn't get into a loop with the surrounding parent.

The 'only-first-correction-sticks' behavior strongly suggests a stale-closure or a competing effect that resets scrollTop after our delta. Log scroller.scrollTop before/after inside the effect to confirm.
AskAI.jsx:90-92 sets scrollRef.scrollTop=scrollHeight on [messages, sending] changes; this doesn't run during practice typing, so it isn't the resetter here.
Character registration continues to work correctly (grey chars in typed range = 0/200).

success_rate.frontend: Character registration PASS 2/2; Caret-in-viewport FAIL 2/2 (desktop 3/20 off-screen, mobile 5/12 off-screen); NEW critical: React max-update-depth overlay on desktop practice.

rca of the issue: The delta-scroll fix does detect the correct scroll ancestor (the AskAI messages `flex-1 overflow-y-auto` container) and the threshold check appears to trigger, but only the first `scroller.scrollTop += delta` persists. Subsequent deltas either don't fire or are reverted, so as typing continues the caret creeps below viewH*0.7 and eventually exits the viewport (desktop after ~900 chars, mobile after ~400 chars). Mobile scroller diagnostic confirms scrollTop=132 (unchanged from open) with scrollHeight=3875, clientHeight=555 -- so the container had ~3.3k px of scroll room that was never used. Combined with a new 'Maximum update depth' React error on desktop, the fix is not shippable. Recommended next fix: switch to useLayoutEffect, guard setCaret against no-op updates, and scroll via scroller.scrollTo({top: scroller.scrollTop+delta}) inside rAF to survive React's batched updates.
